mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the sound-sensitive membranes was most worthwhile because the result explains how movement in cochlear fluid leads to changed nerve signals.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the hearing pathways added little explanation beyond what the picture description already suggested.

surprise.text: The explanation that bending hair-cell bundles changes signals made the transition from vibration to nerve activity clearer.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though most decisions offered only one combination, so the order felt prescribed.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in another chapter if it connected the assembled organs to a new situation. This chapter explained the hearing route clearly, but its mostly single-option steps offered little choice.
